resources.string:
• Monthly goal (25): full marks between your minimum and maximum, 20 while still under the minimum, 10 if no more than 10% over the maximum.
• Category limits (25): the share of your limited categories still within their limit this month.
• Logging habit (25): days with an expense in the last 14 days. 7 days earns full marks.
• Receipt photos (25): full marks once half of this month's expenses have a photo.
